label: Off-duty trooper
note: Issue #314: a Remnant trooper off duty in the ring station's top-floor barracks (content/core/stations/orbital_station.json 'remnant' 'top'), standing round the card tables. Slower to notice you and to react than a trooper on duty, and they fight where they stand (hold_ground): no navmesh aboard, so they never run across the station. Part of the station's Remnant: the station is taken only once they are dead too. Only the blocks below differ from cruiser_trooper.json.
